pageContent.markdown:
Albemarle Street, Mayfair, London W1S 4BP

# Brown's Hotel, Mayfair

A full decorating package for London's oldest hotel: two years as main decorating contractor, delivered while it never stopped taking guests.

![Finished guest bedroom at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair: pale tree-and-leaf wallcovering behind a green patterned headboard, with velvet and fringed botanical cushions under lit wall lights.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/browns-hotel-mayfair-09-800.webp)

## At a glance

Client, materials & project facts

**Client**
: Rocco Forte Hotels

**Designer**
: –Not recorded

**Main contractor**
: –Not recorded

**Maker and paper**
: Lewis & Wood – Adam's Eden (designed by Adam Calkin)

**Area or rooms**
: –Not recorded

**Scope**
: Main decorating contractor

**Year**
: 2022–2024

## At a glance

- **Client / brand:** Brown’s Hotel, Rocco Forte Hotels
- **Location:** Albemarle Street, Mayfair, London
- **Years:** 2022–2024
- **Role:** Main decorating contractor
- **Wallcoverings:** [Lewis & Wood](https://www.lewisandwood.co.uk/) [Adam’s Eden](https://www.lewisandwood.co.uk/wallpapers/adams-eden/), among others
- **Scope:** Wallcovering installation; wall preparation, filling, making good and priming; fine painting; French polishing and specialist finishes; spray-finishing of ornate moulded ceilings

## The building

Brown’s needs little introduction in Mayfair. Long celebrated as dating from 1837, the hotel’s own commissioned research now traces its founding to 1832, when James and Sarah Brown opened their doors at 23 Dover Street. It has never been renamed, rebuilt or relocated, which makes it London’s oldest luxury hotel.

Its guest book reads like a syllabus. Alexander Graham Bell made Britain’s first telephone call here in 1876. Rudyard Kipling came from the day he was married and returned for more than four decades; Agatha Christie’s *At Bertram’s Hotel* owes much to her stays. Theodore Roosevelt stayed before his marriage in 1886, and Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt spent their honeymoon here. Rocco Forte Hotels acquired Brown’s in 2003.

## The brief

To act as main decorating contractor across a sequence of rooms and suites: preparing every surface, hanging premium wallcoverings, fine painting, French polishing and specialist finishes, and spray-finishing the hotel’s richly moulded ceilings. All of it within a fully operating hotel, to programme, around guests in residence.

## Our approach

**Preparation and priming.** Period walls were filled, made good and primed until they were true enough to receive both fine paint and wide-width printed papers. On walls of this age, the hours spent here decide everything that follows.

**Setting out.** Adam’s Eden is a large-scale design with a 108.5 cm half-drop repeat. Each room was set out from its focal points (chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls) so that the birds and branches fall naturally, and so the pattern meets the cornice with composure.

**Ceilings.** The ornate moulded ceilings were spray-finished to give a flawless, even coat that keeps every crisp detail of the plasterwork, something a brush or roller cannot achieve on enrichment of this depth.

**Fine finishes.** Fine painting, French polishing and specialist finishes were carried out by the same team, so that joinery, walls and ceilings were finished as one coherent scheme.

**A live hotel.** Brown’s remained open throughout. We worked closely with the main contractor and the hotel’s management on access, timing, protection and housekeeping, keeping work contained and quiet. The project was delivered on time, with the hotel open throughout.

## Materials

- **[Lewis & Wood – Adam’s Eden](https://www.lewisandwood.co.uk/wallpapers/adams-eden/):** designed by the decorative artist Adam Calkin and one of Lewis & Wood’s signature designs, printed on wide non-woven paper. The design is identified from the printed selvedge photographed on site; the colourway is not recorded here.
- Other wallcoverings appear in our photographs, including a green trailing-leaf design; these are not identified here.

## Outcome

Rooms that feel as though they have always been this way: Adam Calkin’s garden climbing beneath freshly finished plasterwork, and calm, tailored bedrooms. All of it delivered on time, in a hotel that never closed its doors.

The last two photographs, of the hotel’s sign and street entrance, are our own, posted on our Instagram, [@mrwallcover](https://www.instagram.com/mrwallcover/), on 7 February 2022, the day we started this project at Brown’s ([CZqAHTMKcnj](https://www.instagram.com/p/CZqAHTMKcnj/)).

## Photographs

![Narrow bedside at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, papered in pale tree-and-leaf wallcovering, with a sculptural bronze lamp, a wall light and a green patterned headboard.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-10.jpg)

![Close view of Adam's Eden wallcovering by Adam Calkin for Lewis & Wood at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair: a yellow bird on a branch above the printed selvedge.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-06.jpg)

![Adam's Eden wallcovering meeting a carved cornice and decorative plaster ceiling at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, above a door case.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-12.jpg)

![Adam's Eden wallcovering beneath a carved cornice at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, around a door case, with a gilt mirror leaning against the wall.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-11.jpg)

![Finished guest bedroom at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair: grey upholstered headboard, yellow cushions, a checked throw and twin wall lights on pale grey painted walls.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-02.jpg)

![Guest bedroom at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, with tall sash windows, full-length linen curtains, a red armchair and an upholstered bench at the foot of the bed.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-03.jpg)

![Bedside in a finished guest room at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair: a dark wood chest, a wavy-stemmed table lamp and yellow cushions against pale grey painted walls.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-04.jpg)

![Two wooden chairs with yellow seats beside a dark wood bedside chest in a finished guest room at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-05.jpg)

![Navy-painted guest-room door at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, lettered 'Sir Paul Smith' in gold, with a brass lever handle.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-01.jpg)

![Room at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, during works: Adam's Eden wallcovering hung beneath an ornate plaster ceiling and chandelier, with protection board on the floor and a vacuum cleaner in view.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-07.jpg)

![Ornate plaster ceiling and chandelier above walls hung in Adam's Eden wallcovering at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, photographed during works with floor protection and equipment by the door.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/browns-hotel-mayfair-08.jpg)

![Brown's Hotel sign on the Albemarle Street front, Mayfair.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/browns-ig-01-800.webp)

![Street entrance and signage at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/browns-ig-02-800.webp)

How the commission ran

## The same standards, on every commission.

Whether the client is a hotel group, a designer or a household, the job runs the same way. These are the parts a photograph never shows.

01

### Survey and scope, room by room

We measure the wall that will actually be hung, allow for the repeat and the wastage, and write a scope of works room by room before anyone orders paper.

02

### Preparation decides the finish

Walls are filled, made good and primed until they are true. If a wall is not ready for the material specified, we say so before the last drop is ordered.

03

### Protection and containment

Floors, furniture and finished joinery are protected as part of the hang. Work is contained and the place is left tidy each evening. In a home we are visitors; in a hotel we work around the house.

04

### Batch and shade control

Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a corridor of rooms reads as one surface.

05

### Set out from the room's focal points

Pattern is set out from chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls, so the design meets the cornice and the joinery with composure.

06

### One team, then the return visit

The people who start are the people who finish. Four to six weeks after completion we come back to look at every seam and edge, and the workmanship is guaranteed for twelve months.

[See the finish up close: seams, internal corners, edges and joins from our own installations](https://www.mrwallcover.com/details/)

## On site

[Video: Silent 6-second film panning around a finished guest room at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair: a desk and mirror, the bed, and two armchairs by curtained windows.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/video/browns-hotel-mayfair-video-01.mp4)

Silent film, 6 seconds. A slow pan around a finished guest room: the desk and mirror, the bed, then two armchairs by the curtained windows.

[Video: Silent 15-second film walking through a finished room at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, papered in a cream wallcovering with a white botanical trail: the bed, a sofa under a mirror, the window and the desk.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/video/browns-hotel-mayfair-video-02.mp4)

Silent film, 15 seconds. A walk through a finished room papered in a cream wallcovering with a white botanical trail, past the bed, a sofa under a mirror, the window and the desk.

[Video: Silent 7-second film of a bedroom at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, during the works: sage wallcovering with a white leaf pattern on the walls, the floor protected, a laser level and stepladders in the room.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/video/browns-hotel-mayfair-video-03.mp4)

Silent film, 7 seconds. A bedroom during the works, hung in a sage wallcovering with a white leaf pattern, with the floor protected and a laser level and stepladders in the room.

By [Dorin Burcus](https://www.mrwallcover.com/about/#dorin), founder · Last updated 11 October 2026
